# Proposed change

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)

## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose.

## Scope

Which Rails controllers, services, database migrations, security rules, UI or documentation are affected?

## Validation

- [ ] Minitest and documentation validation pass locally.
- [ ] English and Vietnamese documentation stay synchronized.
- [ ] No live API credentials, translation secrets or paid inference are used in tests.
- [ ] Changes are focused and reviewable.

## Security and cost impact

Explain any changes to authentication, authorization, tokens, rate limits, endpoints, queues or potentially billable provider calls.

## Evidence

Provide the exact commit SHA and safe test output. Do not claim GPU acceptance or production readiness without independent evidence.
